divergence_justification: MIMIC-on-FHIR carries no ICU input-event/link-order identifier at MedicationAdministration.identifier.value. The upstream ETL mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:7-23,38-103 neither selects linkorderid nor writes any input-event identifier; its opaque resource UUID cannot recover linkorderid. This explains all 16,892 keyed differing_null_only rows. There are no missing, invented, or conflicting rows, and all representable columns agree on every row. The complete row set and every clinically representable value are reproduced, so the intrinsic gap is accepted rather than blocked.

reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.
